value.text: Our research and development efforts focus on three interconnected ambitions: Reinvent productivity and business processes; Build the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform; Create more personal computing.

strategic_priorities.quote:
To achieve our vision, our research and development efforts focus on three interconnected ambitions:
•
Reinvent productivity and business processes.
•
Build the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform.
•
Create more personal computing.

value.text: Building a distributed computing fabric across cloud and the edge to help every organization build, run, and manage mission-critical workloads anywhere.

strategic_priorities.quote: We are building a distributed computing fabric – across cloud and the edge – to help every organization build, run, and manage mission-critical workloads anywhere.

value.text: Enabling metaverse experiences at all layers of our stack.

strategic_priorities.quote: We are enabling metaverse experiences at all layers of our stack, so customers can more effectively model, automate, simulate, and predict changes within their industrial environments, feel a greater sense of presence in the new world of hybrid work, and create custom immersive worlds to enable new opportunities for connection and experimentation.

value.text: Transforming the workplace to deliver new modern, modular business applications, drive deeper insights, and improve how people communicate, collaborate, learn, work, play, and interact with one another.

strategic_priorities.quote: Transforming the workplace to deliver new modern, modular business applications, drive deeper insights, and improve how people communicate, collaborate, learn, work, play, and interact with one another.

value.text: Building and running cloud-based services in ways that unleash new experiences and opportunities for businesses and individuals.

strategic_priorities.quote: Building and running cloud-based services in ways that unleash new experiences and opportunities for businesses and individuals.

value.text: Applying AI to drive insights and act on our customer's behalf by understanding and interpreting their needs using natural methods of communication.

strategic_priorities.quote: Applying AI to drive insights and act on our customer’s behalf by understanding and interpreting their needs using natural methods of communication.

value.text: Tackling security from all angles with our integrated, end-to-end solutions spanning security, compliance, identity, and management, across all clouds and platforms.

strategic_priorities.quote: Tackling security from all angles with our integrated, end-to-end solutions spanning security, compliance, identity, and management, across all clouds and platforms.

value.text: Inventing new gaming experiences that bring people together around their shared love for games on any devices and pushing the boundaries of innovation with console and PC gaming.

strategic_priorities.quote: Inventing new gaming experiences that bring people together around their shared love for games on any devices and pushing the boundaries of innovation with console and PC gaming by creating the next wave of entertainment.

value.text: Using Windows to fuel our cloud business, grow our share of the PC market, and drive increased engagement with our services.

strategic_priorities.quote: Using Windows to fuel our cloud business, grow our share of the PC market, and drive increased engagement with our services like Microsoft 365 Consumer, Teams, Edge, Bing, Xbox Game Pass, and more.

value.text: Continued investment in high performance and sustainable computing to meet growing demand for Microsoft services provided by our cloud infrastructure and datacenters.

strategic_priorities.quote: We continue to invest in high performance and sustainable computing to meet the growing demand for fast access to Microsoft services provided by our network of cloud computing infrastructure and datacenters.

value.text: Continued investment in gaming content, community, and cloud services, including announced plans to acquire Activision Blizzard.

strategic_priorities.quote: In January 2022, we announced plans to acquire Activision Blizzard , Inc., a leader in game development and an interactive entertainment content publisher .

value.text: Commitment to be carbon negative by 2030 and to remove by 2050 all the carbon emitted since founding in 1975, with $1 billion invested over four years in new climate technologies; plus commitments to be water positive by 2030, zero waste by 2030, and to protect ecosystems.

strategic_priorities.quote: In January 2020, we announced a bold commitment and detailed plan to be carbon negative by 2030, and to remove from the environment by 2050 all the carbon we have emitted since our founding in 1975. This included a commitment to invest $1 billion over four years in new technologies and innovative climate solutions. We built on this pledge by adding commitments to be water positive by 2030, zero waste by 2030, and to protect ecosystems by developing a Planetary Computer.

value.text: Racial Equity Initiative focused on three multi-year pillars, including a $150 million investment to strengthen inclusion and double the number of Black, African American, Hispanic, and Latinx leaders in the U.S. by 2025.

strategic_priorities.quote: Increasing representation and strengthening inclusion: build on our momentum, adding a $150 million investment to strengthen inclusion and double the number of Black, African American, Hispanic, and Latinx leaders in the United States by 2025.

value.text: Accelerating development of mixed reality solutions with new Azure services and devices.

strategic_priorities.quote: We are accelerating our development of mixed reality solutions with new Azure services and devices.

value.text: Maintaining a long-term commitment to research and development across a wide spectrum of technologies, tools, and platforms spanning digital work and life experiences, cloud computing, AI, devices, and operating systems.

strategic_priorities.quote: Based on our assessment of key technology trends, we maintain our long-term commitment to research and development across a wide spectrum of technologies, tools, and platforms spanning digital work and life experiences, cloud computing, AI, devices, and operating systems.

segments.quote: We operate our business and report our financial performance using three segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing.
Our Intelligent Cloud segment consists of our public, private, and hybrid server products and cloud services that can power modern business and developers.
Our More Personal Computing segment consists of products and services that put customers at the center of the experience with our technology.

value.description: Completed acquisition of Nuance Communications, Inc. for a total purchase price of $18.8 billion, consisting primarily of cash; reported as part of Intelligent Cloud segment.

events.quote: On March 4, 2022, we completed our acquisition of Nuance Communications, Inc. (“Nuance”) for a total purchase price of $18.8 billion, consisting primarily of cash. Nuance is a cloud and artificial intelligence (“AI”) software provider with healthcare and enterprise AI experience, and the acquisition will build on our industry-specific cloud offerings.

value.description: Definitive agreement to acquire Activision Blizzard, Inc. for $95.00 per share in an all-cash transaction valued at $68.7 billion; expected to close in fiscal year 2023 subject to regulatory approvals.

events.quote: On January 18, 2022 , we entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Activision Blizzard , Inc. (“Activision Blizzard” ) for $ 95 .00 per share in an all-cash transaction valued at $ 68 .7 billion, inclusive of Activision Blizzard’s net cash. The acquisition has been approved by Activision Blizzard’s shareholders, and we expect it to close in fiscal year 2023, subject to the satisfaction of certain regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions.

value.description: Change in accounting estimate: useful lives of server and network equipment increased from four years to six years, effective fiscal year 2023, estimated to increase FY2023 operating income by $3.7 billion.

events.quote: In July 2022, we completed an assessment of the useful lives of our server and network equipment. Due to investments in software that increased efficiencies in how we operate our server and network equipment, as well as advances in technology, we determined we should increase the estimated useful lives of both server and network equipment from four years to six years.

value.description: Transfer of certain intangible properties from Puerto Rico subsidiary to the U.S., resulting in a $3.3 billion net income tax benefit in Q1 FY2022.

events.quote: In the first quarter of fiscal year 2022, we transferred certain intangible properties from our Puerto Rico subsidiary to the U.S. The transfer of intangible properties resulted in a $3.3 billion net income tax benefit in the first quarter of fiscal year 2022, as the value of future U.S. tax deductions exceeds the current tax liability from the U.S. global intangible low-taxed income tax.

value.description: Share repurchases of 95 million shares for $28.0 billion in fiscal year 2022; $40.7 billion remained of the $60 billion program as of June 30, 2022.

events.quote: During fiscal years 2022 and 2021, we repurchased 95 million shares and 101 million shares of our common stock for $28.0 billion and $23.0 billion, respectively, through our share repurchase programs. All repurchases were made using cash resources. As of June 30, 2022, $40.7 billion remained of our $60 billion share repurchase program.

events.quote: During fiscal year 2022, our Board of Directors declared quarterly dividends of $0.62 per share. We intend to continue returning capital to shareholders in the form of dividends, subject to declaration by our Board of Directors.

value.why_notable: A direct admission that ongoing investment is expected to raise costs and may compress margins — recurring but unusually plain language about a negative consequence.

notable_language.quote: The investments we are making in infrastructure and devices will continue to increase our operating costs and may decrease our operating margins.

value.why_notable: Hedged framing of macro and geopolitical exposure — "remain dynamic" as a euphemism for uncertainty in a year of macro deterioration.

notable_language.quote: Aggregate demand for our software, services, and devices is correlated to global macroeconomic and geopolitical factors, which remain dynamic.

value.why_notable: Management pre-frames slower Gaming growth as an artifact of a tough comparable and pandemic "stay-at-home scenarios" rather than demand weakness.

notable_language.quote: Gaming revenue increased $860 million or 6% on a strong prior year comparable that benefited from Xbox Series X|S launches and stay-at-home scenarios, driven by growth in Xbox hardware and Xbox content and services.

value.why_notable: Reported margin declined, and the improvement is only visible after excluding a prior-year accounting estimate change — an important qualification on the margin narrative.

notable_language.quote: Gross margin percentage decreased slightly. Excluding the impact of the fiscal year 2021 change in accounting estimate for the useful lives of our server and network equipment, gross margin percentage increased 1 point driven by improvement in Productivity and Business Processes.

value.why_notable: Explicit supply-chain concentration admission: few qualified suppliers and limited near-term flexibility to substitute manufacturers.

notable_language.quote: Extended disruptions at these suppliers and/or manufacturers could lead to a similar disruption in our ability to manufacture devices on time to meet consumer demand.

value.why_notable: The recurring self-description/mission statement — the baseline phrasing against which year-over-year changes in self-characterisation are measured.

notable_language.quote: Microsoft is a technology company whose mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We strive to create local opportunity, growth, and impact in every country around the world.

value.why_notable: Forward-looking commitment to rising capex, signaling sustained cloud infrastructure buildout.

notable_language.quote: We expect capital expenditures to increase in coming years to support growth in our cloud offerings.

value.why_notable: States the rationale for the shift to 100% PSA for the CEO, and explicitly frames it as replacing the incentive lost when the 2014 promotion award finished vesting.

notable_language.quote: After a thorough analysis of options, our independent Board members concluded that it would be best to deliver Mr. Nadella’s compensation under our existing Executive Incentive Plan framework to ensure an ongoing strong alignment to the incentives of the senior leadership team, while delivering 100% of his equity compensation via performance stock awards (up from 70% in fiscal year 2021).

value.why_notable: Justifies a $50M target award by appeal to the CEO's 'extraordinary capabilities' and the company's 'extraordinary scale' rather than to a benchmarked figure — pay-level justification by superlative.

notable_language.quote: For fiscal year 2022, Mr. Nadella’s target performance stock award was set at $50,000,000, which our independent Board members concluded is the appropriate level of equity compensation for a leader with his extraordinary capabilities and responsibilities and for a company of Microsoft’s extraordinary scale and complexity.

value.why_notable: Explains a metric-category change as a renaming for clarity in response to investor requests, not a change in substance — a label change presented as ESG-linkage progress.

notable_language.quote: Beginning with fiscal year 2022, we renamed the Culture & Organizational Leadership category of the operational assessment component of the annual cash incentive as the Culture, Diversity & Sustainability category to enhance clarity on how ESG results affect the pay of our named executives.

value.why_notable: Pre-emptively reframes a below-target revenue result as evidence of goal rigor rather than of underperformance.

notable_language.quote: We note that our Incentive Plan Revenue result was at 99.7% of target while achieving a 18.37% fiscal year 2022 growth rate, demonstrating our commitment to rigorous goal setting.

value.why_notable: Recurring rigor claim; worth tracking against the FY22 PSA results where Teams usage paid 50.92% and Game Pass 56.80% against targets.

notable_language.quote: The Committee establishes rigorous goals for each metric that require significant year-over-year improvement in order for target awards to be earned

value.why_notable: Attributes the impetus for a large CEO award to shareholder feedback, aligning investor voice with the board's own conclusion — key-man framing used to support pay quantum.

notable_language.quote: Mr. Nadella’s criticality to Microsoft’s ongoing success was a regular focus of feedback we received from shareholders, which is consistent with our independent Board members’ high confidence in Mr. Nadella’s exceptional leadership of Microsoft.

value.why_notable: Documents a benchmarking change — a single peer group split into primary technology and secondary large-cap general industry groups.

notable_language.quote: For fiscal year 2022, the Compensation Committee reviewed the evolution of our business against our historical peer group, and as a result approved the use of two peer groups to better reflect the differentiated business, talent and, in some cases, pay models, across sectors:

value.why_notable: Unusually direct admission that the peer groups understate the company's size and that this scale gap is used as an upward factor in pay setting.

notable_language.quote: Given Microsoft’s significant scale and growth, Microsoft is larger than the typical company in both peer groups, which is a factor when we set executive pay.

value.why_notable: Market-condition language used to justify pay increases; the 'hyper-competitive' framing is a year-specific escalation worth tracking.

notable_language.quote: The current technology labor market is hyper-competitive with demand growing faster than the supply of specialized technical talent, resulting in significant increases in compensation at many of the companies with which we compete for this talent.

value.why_notable: Defends the practice of resetting PSA targets annually within a three-year period — a design that softens long-horizon risk, justified as more accurate.

notable_language.quote: Due to the dynamic nature of our business and the specificity in the performance metrics that are chosen under our PSA program, we believe that measuring performance annually over our three-year performance period and modifying awards based on our three-year relative TSR provides the most accurate assessment of Microsoft’s long-term trajectory and performance achievements.

value.why_notable: Disclosure hedge: prior-year absolute targets are withheld 'for competitive reasons' and restated as growth rates, reducing year-over-year comparability.

notable_language.quote: Metrics were established as unit of measure or dollar value before FY22. For competitive reasons, results for those years are expressed in terms of year-over-year growth. Beginning in FY22 metrics were defined as a growth percentage.

value.why_notable: 'No fault' clawback extending to nonfinancial performance restatements and to significant legal or compliance violations — broader than the statutory minimum.

notable_language.quote: Our Compensation Committee may seek to recover payments of incentive compensation if the performance results leading to a payment are later subject to a downward adjustment or restatement of financial or nonfinancial performance.

value.why_notable: Explicit disclaimer of percentile targeting, which preserves discretion while the disclosure elsewhere leans on peer-group scale comparisons.

notable_language.quote: We do not tie Named Executive compensation to specific market percentiles.

value.why_notable: The only non-formulaic cash payment to an NEO in FY22, with a repayment condition on resignation or termination for misconduct.

notable_language.quote: In connection with his employment as our Executive Vice President, Business Development, Strategy, and Ventures on November 11, 2020, our Compensation Committee awarded Mr. Young an on-hire cash bonus with a second $1,500,000 installment payable within 30 days after the first anniversary of his employment start date.

value.why_notable: An explicit negative statement that no discretionary or off-plan awards were made — useful as a baseline against which any future special award would stand out.

notable_language.quote: During fiscal year 2022, the Compensation Committee and independent members of our Board awarded no other compensation to our Named Executives.

segments_basis.basis: reportable segments as named by the filing

investor_qa_basis.basis: management's written answers to questions submitted by investors, published roughly monthly. Same verification as every other fact — whole-document boundaries and a checked quote — but a different kind of evidence from a 10-K or proxy statement: unaudited, unprompted by any disclosure requirement, and responsive to whatever was asked. Corroborating; not a substitute for a filed disclosure.

ids.basis: content hash of the claim, its evidence and its source — see `fact_id` in src/equity_research/ledger_schema.py. Confidence and the verification result are NOT hashed, so re-verifying a fact does not renumber it. Cross-year uniqueness is enforced fatally at build time by `audit_ids`.

document_window.basis: filing dates of the documents this year's facts are actually drawn from — NOT the fiscal window in inventory.json, which bounds the fiscal years in scope. Documents reporting on a fiscal year are filed after it ends, so this range extends past window_end_date by construction. Any accession listed above additionally belongs to a fiscal year outside the window and is used deliberately: an annual-meeting vote held in May of year N decides on year N-1.

corrections.basis: config/corrections.toml — human corrections to model-extracted values that the cited filing contradicts, each carrying the filing text that establishes it. data/ledger/facts/ is never edited: the record of what the model returned has to stay as it was.
